_description: Canonical reference and prompt history for all 8 visual novel backgrounds (plus 2 full-screen GUI menu backdrops) in DAOCUBATOR / 'Get Rich Together'. Includes what each background represents, every scene where it is used across the 5 chapters & 8 endings, stage/lighting requirements for the 3D 24k gold character sprites, and all prompts/approaches tried so far.

specs.renpy_naming_rule: Files in game/images/ MUST be named 'bg <id>.png' (with a space) so Ren'Py auto-registers them for `scene bg <id>` calls.
specs.staging_notes: Upper 2/3 of the 1920x1080 frame holds waist-up 3D polished 24k gold character sculptures (at xalign 0.18 left, 0.50 center, 0.82 right) and bottom 277px is covered by the dark-glass dialogue textbox (`game/gui/textbox.png`). Backgrounds need clear mid-ground/foreground breathing room and controlled value contrast so the golden character silhouettes read cleanly.

v0_prototype_retrodiffusion.style: 90s PC-98 pixel art via Retrodiffusion API URLs (never rendered to bitmaps in the prototypes; prototypes used CSS/emoji).

v0_scripted_pc98_placeholders.style: Programmatic PIL 16-color NEC PC-98 ordered-Bayer dithered geometric placeholders with 8px chunky cells and CRT scanlines. Backed up in `vault/06 Assets/placeholders_backup/`.

artist_test_junk_journal.style: Victorian antique scrapbooking / junk-journal collage (19th-century botanical engravings, dried pressed roses, brass skeleton keys, wax sealing stamps, sepia postcards). Rejected because it pulled the tone toward historical mystery rather than Web3/DAO coordination and modern collective building.

v1_mixed_media_asya_moodboard.era: First AI-generated mixed-media pass (`vault/06 Assets/generated_backgrounds/`, currently in `game/images/`)
v1_mixed_media_asya_moodboard.style: Organic-cybernetic mixed media inspired by Asya Abdrahman's initial moodboards (`vault/06 Assets/moodboard/direction_from_asya/`): layered acrylic/gouache washes, torn paper collage, distressed gold leaf PCB circuit traces, and solarpunk/cyber details.
v1_mixed_media_asya_moodboard.why_new_direction_needed: While tactile, v1 mixed literal room/UI illustrations with busy gold-leaf circuit overlays that compete with the new monolithic 3D 24k gold character sprites and predated the deeper analysis in Asya's 7-Board Corpus (`research/seven-boards-abdrahman.html` — Register A Burnished, Register B Abjad, Register C Pulp, Frame & Suspension, Process & Elements).

conference.what_it_represents: The public, formal, high-stakes arena. Crypto-conference hall, pitch stage, mixer floor, and constitutional assembly room where money, power, legal liability, and governance votes collide in public view.
conference.what_to_depict: Crypto-conference hall / pitch stage — big presentation screen with DAO/ETH banners or network emblems, stage spotlights, tiered seating in shadow. Open foreground stage to frame 1–3 speaking character sprites.

scenes_used.summary: Alex critiques your unallocated tokenomics draft at a DeFi conference and pitches joining as treasury lead.

scenes_used.beat: Vera at the mixer — the legal wrapper
scenes_used.summary: At an after-hours mixer, ex-union organizer Vera asks 'Who's liable when this goes wrong?' and offers the $15k Swiss Verein legal wrapper.
Maya and Alex debate holding 90% native token vs. a 30–50% stablecoin barbell.
Atlas offers 500 ETH 'no strings attached' while Alex whispers an aside about whale leverage.
Alex presents a major distributor's cross-collateralized 360 advance offer.
Vera offers patient angel capital (20 ETH, no board seat, monthly truth dinner) as an alternative to Atlas.
Public governance crisis as Proposal #17 ('Redistribute founder tokens to the community') hits 35% support.
If loyal, Alex discloses that Atlas bought them dinner and offered an 'advisory role'.
A paper envelope from a financial regulator arrives questioning the token event (payoff of Ch1.6 Swiss Verein choice).
BigCorp sends a formal acquisition offer ('Exploring Strategic Alignment') to buy out the tired collective.
The Constitutional Vote on Day 90: Full Decentralization vs. Balanced Governance vs. Benevolent Leadership.
Papers sign smoothly; everyone gets jobs at BigCorp and the mission statement gets a redirect notice.
Founders kept control of everything except the point; polite performative votes in a centralized hall.

prompts_tried.prompt: pixel art corporate boardroom conference table projector screen intimidating 90s aesthetic

prompts_tried.description: Ordered Bayer dither gradient from blue (#0000AA) to deep blue (#000080), black stage screen with bright cyan border (#55FFFF), dark gray stage floor, and black silhouettes of audience heads.

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of a high-stakes crypto conference hall and illuminated presentation stage. The stage has a glowing presentation screen displaying abstract golden DAO network graphs and decentralized emblems. Stage lighting spotlights cast dramatic warm golden and cyan beams across the stage. Tiered auditorium rows with silhouettes of seated audience members are visible in the dim background. The stage foreground is open and ready for a speaker. Mixed media art style: richly textured abstract painting, layered acrylic washes with rich crimson, amber, and deep charcoal, distressed gold leaf accents, fine golden circuit board traces running across structural pillars, collage paper textures with raw tactile edges. High-stakes, grand, theatrical atmosphere.

discord.what_it_represents: The digital town square at 2–3 AM. Where community hype, memes, governance apathy, operational leaks, phishing links, and factional arguments happen in real time.
discord.what_to_depict: Stylized Discord server / online community space at 2–3 AM — channel/member rail, active chat stream, dark nocturnal glow. The online collective space.

scenes_used.summary: Jordan introduces the blowing-up Discord server and asks how to handle trolls, quiet quitters, and onboarding.
Ten thousand members flood the server before the Token Generation Event—believers and vultures cheering alike.

scenes_used.beat: Route beat — Viral Drop Overfunding Paradox
scenes_used.summary: Jordan celebrates the drop hitting 300% of goal while Maya realizes unit economics are negative $15 per unit.
Jordan reports that mod pixel_pal pasted the multisig seed phrase into the team Notion 'just temporarily' for six hours.
Voter turnout drops to 6.3% while Jordan is buried under 400 DMs a day and loud non-contributors complain about the logo.
Members report weird token approval popups on the live mint site after a stolen CDN key injects malicious script.
A carbon-credit protocol pitches a 'regenerative culture partnership' that turns out to be 2011 junk hydro credits.
47 proposals pending, 4.1% turnout; the server becomes a beautifully governed ghost town with perfect process and no pulse.

prompts_tried.description: Ordered Bayer dither gradient from black (#000000) to deep blue (#000080), left server rail in dark gray (#555555) with colored circular server icons, and deep-blue chat message boxes outlined in cyan (#00AAAA).

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of a stylized late-night online community chatroom and Discord interface at 3 AM. A dark sleek interface abstractly depicting a channel sidebar, active glowing chat stream columns, message cards, and online member nodes. Atmospheric dark glow with deep midnight charcoal, luminous neon cyan and magenta watercolor bleeds, soft luminous ambient glow from active discussions. Mixed media art style: rich textured watercolor and acrylic washes on dark textured handmade paper, distressed gold leaf circuit board traces connecting community nodes like a constellation network, torn paper collage edges, fine calligraphic marks and subtle digital glitch textures. Mysterious, vibrant, nocturnal online community space.

coworking.what_it_represents: The physical workshop where the core team actually builds, argues over equity, ships product, counts casualties the morning after the attack, and settles into sustainable work.
coworking.what_to_depict: Startup co-working office — wooden desks, monitors, architectural whiteboard, loft window with daylight. Grounded, human workspace.

scenes_used.beat: Cold open, Meet Maya & The Equity Conversation — KEYSTONE
scenes_used.summary: Day 1 after quitting BigCorp: choosing the venture type (label/streetwear/collective), recruiting Maya, and negotiating the co-founder equity split (50/50 vs. 60/40 vs. 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff).
The Genesis Block is complete and the collective is born.

scenes_used.beat: Route beat — Streetwear Full Collection vs. One Hoodie
scenes_used.summary: Jordan pitches an 8-piece cut-and-sew collection that risks a fulfillment and chargeback death spiral.
Exhausted after eight months of deferred salary, Maya reveals a competitor offered her 3x salary—testing whether you have vesting or end up with dead equity on the cap table.
Day-after casualty accounting in the office after surviving the Chapter 4 attack.
Day 90 check-in at the workspace with Maya and Jordan before the final resolution beats.
No unicorn, no monument—artists paid on time, decisions made in the open, a boring resilient treasury, and a founder who sleeps well.

prompts_tried.prompt: pixel art trendy coworking space open plan bean bags monitors 90s aesthetic / pixel art startup office interior desks computers whiteboard windows 90s aesthetic

prompts_tried.description: Ordered Bayer dither gradient from deep blue (#000080) to black (#000000), dark gray floor, brown desks with cyan-bordered monitors, and a bright-cyan framed window on the right.

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of a startup co-working office space where a tech team builds together. Wooden desks with multiple computer monitors, open laptops showing code and charts, coffee cups, notebooks, an architectural whiteboard covered with diagrams and sticky notes, lush indoor houseplants, and wide loft windows with warm natural sunlight streaming across the room. Mixed media art style: rich textured abstract painting surfaces, layered acrylic and gouache washes, raw torn handmade paper collage elements, distressed gold leaf accents with subtle organic circuit board traces, earthy terracotta, warm ochre, soft olive green, and slate tones. Collaborative, vibrant, creative atmosphere.

blockchain.what_it_represents: 'The Chain.' The immutable, impersonal protocol layer where tokens are minted, whale wallets accumulate in silence, 51% governance attacks execute without mercy, and treasury death spirals play out mathematically.
blockchain.what_to_depict: Abstract on-chain visualization — glowing node graph, cryptographic edges and blocks, high-contrast cyber/protocol space.

scenes_used.summary: Opening narration ('NounsDAO. MakerDAO. The Aragon crisis. ConstitutionDAO...') and player name entry before jumping to Chapter 1.

scenes_used.beat: Token design ceremony + Atlas mint-night foreshadow
scenes_used.summary: Setting initial token allocation (Founder Split vs. Merit vs. 60% Community Treasury) and witnessing Atlas's anonymous whale deposit materialize from shadow.
The token goes live, governance activates, and someone makes a shrine to the genesis block number.

scenes_used.beat: Day 60 — The Attack intro & Spectre's warning
scenes_used.summary: 'Something is wrong with the chain the way something can be wrong with a house at night.' Spectre gives an earned warning before routing to the vulnerability vector.
Red Alert: Atlas's 11 wallets cross 45% of governance tokens and submit a 'Treasury Diversification Initiative' containing a hidden drain function.
Market drops 40% in a week, and the 90%-native-token treasury loses 70% of its purchasing power right before Thursday payroll.
The treasury address updates one last time; whoever holds the keys posts a single 'gg' before archiving the forum.

prompts_tried.description: Ordered Bayer dither gradient from black (#000000) to deep blue (#000080) with a 12-node elliptical ring connected by cyan chords (#00AAAA) and alternating bright magenta (#FF55FF) and bright cyan (#55FFFF) square nodes.

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of an abstract blockchain network and cryptographic ledger visualization. Glowing geometric node clusters and cryptographic blocks floating in deep space, connected by radiant cyan, electric magenta, and gold conductive data threads. Sacred geometry spirals, mathematical mesh grids, and hash data rings. Mixed media art style: cosmic deep indigo and black textured canvas, rich impasto oil paint texture, shimmering distressed gold leaf foil circuit pathways, luminous translucent resin layers, tactile torn parchment collage elements. Hypnotic, monumental, cyber-organic.

apartment.what_it_represents: The private, isolated, exhausted founder headspace at 1:00–4:00 AM. Where encrypted zero-day warnings arrive, where burnout stares back from the mirror, where late-night phishing mistakes happen, and where Jordan calls when neither of you can sleep.
apartment.what_to_depict: Late-night apartment at 3 AM — desk with laptop glow, mug, rain/city lights through a dark window. Intimate, quiet, exhausted atmosphere.

scenes_used.summary: An anonymous hooded account messages you at 2:47 AM about a reentrancy vulnerability in your unlaunched mint contract.
72 hours before launch, Spectre asks for 20 ETH and admin access to run a proper smart-contract audit.
Spectre flags 11 fresh wallets buying governance tokens in a coordinated drip pattern with identical gas habits.
At 4:11 AM, you re-read your own launch-day post ('We're going to do this sustainably') and choose whether to step back, power through, or confide in someone.
Late at night, a routine vendor invoice payout is queued on a mysteriously auto-updated browser wallet extension.
On the eve of the final vote, an exhausted Jordan calls at 3 AM to ask honestly: 'Was it worth it?'
Triggered if Burnout hits 80 at chapter close: your hands won't stop shaking at 3 AM and Maya/Jordan lock you out of the multisig for 72 hours.

prompts_tried.description: Ordered Bayer dither gradient from black (#000000) to magenta (#AA00AA), right window showing yellow city building lights on deep blue, brown couch, and bright-cyan glowing laptop screen.

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of a late-night apartment room at 3 AM. A messy work desk with an illuminated laptop casting soft blue and cyan light, a warm ceramic coffee mug, sticky notes, and headphones. A large window overlooks a dark rainy cityscape with soft warm glowing bokeh lights and reflections. Mixed media art style: richly textured abstract painting surfaces, layered acrylic and gouache washes, distressed gold leaf accents, earthy warm ochre and terracotta mixed with deep indigo and midnight teal, textured handmade paper collage details, fine golden conductive circuit-like filament lines subtly woven through the textures. Atmospheric, introspective, exhausted yet beautiful.

factionmap.what_it_represents: The strategic war-room view of governance power. More diagram/table than physical room: visualizes how token voting power concentrates (top 10% holding 76.2% of power) and how the collective fractures into three competing blocks (Decentralists, Pragmatists, Opportunists).
factionmap.what_to_depict: Governance dashboard / tactical diagram — three faction spheres/circles (Decentralists / Pragmatists / Opportunists), voting power pie charts, delegation flows. Also serves as the backdrop for the end-of-run recap screen.

scenes_used.summary: With voter turnout falling, someone livestreams a pie chart showing the top 10% of voters hold 76.2% of power; you choose between liquid delegation, quadratic voting, or leaving 1-token-1-vote.
'The map hardens: Decentralists. Pragmatists. Opportunists. Everyone's sure they're in the first two.'
Three forked DAOs now share one dream, two grudges, and a fractured treasury.
Plays at the end of every playthrough to list your pivotal decisions and how many of the 15 failure-mode lessons you unlocked.

prompts_tried.description: Ordered Bayer dither gradient from deep blue (#000080) to black (#000000) with three large overlapping faction rings in bright cyan (#55FFFF), orange (#FFAA55), and bright magenta (#FF55FF).

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of an intricate DAO governance dashboard and voting constellation map. Three distinct circular faction spheres and interlocking celestial diagram rings labeled with data readouts, token percentages, and voting weight flows. Mixed media art style: deep slate-charcoal fine art paper background, rich metallic gold leaf circuit board traces connecting decision nodes, weathered copper and patina teal washes, calligraphic ink diagrams, tactile layered paper collage with subtle geometric grid textures. Sophisticated, tactile data visualization.

rooftop.what_it_represents: Perspective, dawn after the long night, and historical continuity. Where Vera delivers her closing thesis across every ending ('The tools are new. The work is old. The work was always each other.') and where the Golden Ending ('Collective Prosperity') celebrates a resilient constitution.
rooftop.what_to_depict: Rooftop terrace at dawn — city skyline silhouette, magenta-to-amber sunrise sky, open foreground terrace for Vera and Spectre.

scenes_used.summary: Plays in every ending (with warm, stern, or mixed delivery): Vera reflects on how governance tools change but human coordination remains the real work.
The constitution has calluses, the treasury has boring parts, other founders fork your governance docs—and if Spectre's relationship >= 80, Spectre almost reveals their real name at dawn.

prompts_tried.description: Ordered Bayer dither gradient from magenta (#AA00AA) to orange (#FFAA55), large yellow rising sun (#FFFF55), black city building silhouettes, and dark gray rooftop deck.

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of a rooftop terrace garden overlooking an expansive modern city at the break of dawn. Dramatic sunrise sky transitioning smoothly from deep violet and magenta to glowing golden amber and warm peach. Potted rooftop greenery, wooden decking, railing overlooking a silhouetted skyline bathed in early morning sunbeams. The center and foreground terrace are spacious and open for characters to stand. Mixed media art style: expressive palette knife oil painting skies with luminous glazing, torn handmade paper collage textures, warm metallic gold leaf catching the dawn sunlight on architectural edges, earthy terracotta planters and natural wood. Inspiring, peaceful, radiant with hope.

signing.what_it_represents: The 'Verify the Hex' interactive set piece (Ch4a.2). A claustrophobic, high-tension close-up at 1:14 AM where a malware-spoofed browser UI says everything is fine ('To: Vendor Payments Ltd ✓'), and only expanding the raw hexadecimal calldata on the hardware wallet reveals the attacker's drain address.
signing.what_to_depict: Hardware-wallet & MetaMask/web3 signing modal close-up — 'SIGN TRANSACTION?', clean summary rows vs. raw `[EXPAND RAW DATA]` hex block (`0x4A21...9DEB` vs `0x7C3f...a91E`), prominent green Confirm and red Reject buttons. No character sprites are shown during this beat; the background IS the set piece.

scenes_used.beat: THE SET PIECE — Verify the Hex
scenes_used.summary: At 1:14 AM, you must decide whether to click the big green SIGN button on a routine 12.5 ETH invoice or expand the raw hex data to catch a blind-signing malware swap.

prompts_tried.description: Solid black background with a centered deep-blue modal window, cyan-bordered summary header, dark-gray raw hex data bars, and bright green Confirm / bright red Reject buttons.

prompts_tried.prompt: A visual novel background of a dramatic, tactile web3 transaction signing workstation. In the sharp foreground on a dark textured slate and wooden desk sits a physical cryptocurrency hardware wallet (matte black and brushed aluminum device with a glowing blue OLED mini-screen displaying a cryptographic recipient address and raw hex data), connected via a braided USB cable with delicate glowing gold filament accents. Next to it lie handwritten security notes on torn paper and sticky notes with warning scribbles. In the close background, an illuminated laptop screen displays the web3 signing modal with 'SIGN TRANSACTION?', summary rows, an expandable bytecode hex block, and glowing green 'Confirm' and red 'Reject' seals. Mixed media art style: rich textured abstract painting surfaces, distressed gold leaf circuit board traces radiating across the desk, deep charcoal, dark indigo, and burnished copper washes, layered paper collage edges. High-stakes, tactile, forensic cyber-security tension.

main_menu.what_it_represents: Title screen key visual. Needs a dark scrim on the left third so main menu navigation buttons ('Start', 'Load', 'Glossary', 'Preferences', 'About', 'Quit') read with high contrast.

prompts_tried.prompt: An evocative visual novel title screen key visual in mixed media art style following Asya Abdrahman fine art direction. An epic central tree of life composed of intricate glowing gold leaf circuit board filament traces and mycelium root networks, connecting to floating crystalline geometric DAO governance tokens and glowing celestial network nodes. Layered paper collage textures, deep midnight navy and rich dark slate watercolor washes, distressed gold foil leafing, and delicate ink contour lines with subtle drifting sakura blossom petals. Grand, contemplative, high-end fine art aesthetic, wide panoramic composition, clean and cinematic, no typography or text.

game_menu.what_it_represents: Shared backdrop for Save, Load, Preferences, History, About, and Codex/Glossary screens (and `game/gui/nvl.png`). Needs a quiet, dark, low-contrast center so UI text and cards remain legible.

prompts_tried.prompt: An atmospheric visual novel menu background companion piece in the same mixed media fine art style following Asya Abdrahman direction. Deep midnight blue, dark charcoal and indigo watercolor washes, layered fine paper collage textures, and delicate distressed gold leaf foil accents framing the perimeter and corners. Subtle, elegant glowing golden circuit board filament traces and node constellations around the edges and left margins, with a clean, dark, moody center suitable for displaying UI text and data screens. Quiet, contemplative, luxurious tech aesthetic. No text or logos.
